Ethereum own mevETH liquid-staking receipt contract only; no curator-labelled Morpho/Lagoon vault. Nonproxy deployed root 0x24ae2da0f361aa4be46b48eb19c91e02c5e4f27e, Sourcify creationMatch/runtimeMatch are match (not exact_match). Staking module and share vault are administrator-changeable after seven-day commit delays. Point-in-time stakingPaused=false and initialized=true are not continuing availability guarantees.

Deposit/mint pull WETH solely from msg.sender when msg.value=0, otherwise require msg.value exactly equal computed assets; mint mevETH to designated receiver. Underlying and shares use 18 decimals; minimum deposit is 0.01 ETH. Accounting downcasts to uint128: amounts and resulting share/asset totals must fit this width. This implementation floors both conversion directions, including mint and withdraw; do not assume standard ERC4626 upward rounding. No caller min-output/max-input/deadline guard.

Withdraw/redeem/withdrawQueue burn owner shares; a non-owner caller must have preexisting share allowance, which catalog does not grant. Payout is WETH to specified receiver. Withdrawal minimum is mutable. Source charges a floor-rounded 1/10000 fee: withdraw adds asset fee before share conversion; redeem subtracts share fee before asset conversion. Last-holder fee exception differs by method. Source fees take precedence over documentation saying no redeem fee.

withdraw and redeem require sufficient unreserved ETH. withdrawQueue pays available WETH immediately and records only the remainder in a fixed-receiver ticket, after burning all shares; return/event assets are not proof all funds paid. Operator must finalize tickets and validator funds must arrive before claim. claim is public but only pays the ticket fixed receiver and cannot redirect. No payout date or complete queued exit guaranteed.

Same-block reward/deposit sandwich guard may revert. Staking rewards/slashing and mutable staking dependencies affect accounting and redemption value; independent dependency runtime attestation not performed. Admin/operator management, validator operations, permissions and historic crETH2 migration excluded.
